fields.v: Same 200 events encoded in 4 formats; same 5 questions; same model (claude-sonnet-4-6), fresh isolated session per format, no extended thinking. Baseline: Format A. Acceptance: answer correctness (criteria Not stated). Repetitions: 1 session per format. Human intervention: Not stated

All formats 5/5 correct; human-readable cheapest in session tokens (18.9k) and time; compressed C +67.2% session tokens despite -17.1% input tokens; decoder tool reduces C's cost to 28.3k but adds tool overhead. No statistical test

Distinguished cost, not correctness (ceiling 5/5). Not repeatable as reported (single run per format). Limitations stated: single model, single dataset, crossover point not established; experiment covers data retrieval, not code architecture (proxy gap)

Training distribution paradox (agent-optimal structures underrepresented); Lost-in-the-Middle challenges large files; human reviewer cognitive debt; proxy gap (architectural claims not experimentally validated); single model and dataset. Future: compression crossover, controlled CODEMAP.md evaluation, file consolidation, ceremony-to-logic formalisation, LLM-native language
